statement.zh: 迪亚拉平原由调查重建的聚落史（与发掘遗址互补）见 Adams《巴格达背后的土地》（1965）。
statement.en: On the Diyala plains, settlement history reconstructed from survey (complementary to excavated Diyala sites) is documented in Adams Land Behind Baghdad (1965).
